creep.title: Creep
creep.note: Four bars, one chord each, for the entire song. The purest test there is of whether the form layer knows a section repeats.

zombie.title: Zombie
zombie.note: Em C G D throughout, in a minor key, with a loud/quiet dynamic that the energy probe has to survive.

im-yours.title: I'm Yours
im-yours.note: C G Am F throughout. Offbeat reggae strum — onsets land between beats, which the beat tracker has to not follow.

three-little-birds.title: Three Little Birds
three-little-birds.note: A D E, with a verse and a chorus that differ. Three chords, so a vocabulary bigger than four is transcribing noise.

country-roads.title: Take Me Home, Country Roads
country-roads.note: A major, verse and chorus harmonically distinct — the form score has something to be wrong about.

wonderwall.title: Wonderwall
wonderwall.note: Played in Em shapes with a capo at 2, so the recording sounds in F# minor. Every published chart is in the wrong key on purpose; this one is not.

someone-like-you.title: Someone Like You
someone-like-you.note: Piano only, arpeggiated. No strum, no band — the chord engine has the least evidence per frame here.

dont-stop-believin.title: Don't Stop Believin'
dont-stop-believin.note: E major, four-bar loop, but the chorus arrives once at the very end — a form with a genuine hapax in it.

viva-la-vida.title: Viva La Vida
viva-la-vida.note: Ab major: no open strings, strings and timpani rather than guitar. The key nothing in a guitar corpus would catch.

smooth-criminal.title: Smooth Criminal
smooth-criminal.note: The owner's own failing case, on the exact video they ran: the 9:26 short film, whose first minute is dialogue and whose song proper is an Am vamp.

mary-janes-last-dance.title: Mary Jane's Last Dance
mary-janes-last-dance.note: 48 cents sharp — the only recording in the book that is not at concert pitch, and the one case that exercises the tuning gate and the semitone slip. Added 2026-08-18 with the analysis audit; the ten songs above remain the row every earlier number in the docs was measured on.
